_comment: SIMPLE TEMPLATE - Just add your key and PCIDs
_instructions: 1. Copy the object below (between the curly braces)
3. Add it to the 'activationKeys' array (don't forget the comma between entries!)
4. Replace the id, productKey, and pcids with your actual values

_notes.pcids: Array of 1-15 PCIDs, each 16 hex characters (required)

_critical_warning: ⚠️ ALL PCIDs MUST BE PAIRED WITH THIS PRODUCT KEY! ⚠️
_pcid_format: 16 hex characters, no 0x prefix, no dashes. Example: abcdef0123456789
_how_it_works: Launcher randomly selects one PCID from array, sets it, provides the paired key
